groups.name: kardx.startup-log
groups.description: Logs API documentation URLs when the app starts (kardx-boot).

properties.name: kardx.language
properties.description: Language of the default log texts: en or ko. Defaults to the value written by the Gradle plugin, else en.

properties.name: kardx.docs-path
properties.description: Docs path inside the static resources (static/ etc.). Matches the Gradle plugin's bootJar.path (static/docs).

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.enabled
properties.description: Logs the docs URLs at INFO when the app starts.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.title
properties.description: Line prefix. Defaults to the text for kardx.language (API docs in English).

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.rest-docs.label
properties.description: REST Docs HTML: name shown in the log.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.rest-docs.enabled
properties.description: REST Docs HTML: whether to include it in the log.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.rest-docs.file
properties.description: REST Docs HTML: file name inside the docs path (docs-path).

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.swagger-ui.label
properties.description: Swagger UI (springdoc); the URL comes from springdoc.swagger-ui.path: name shown in the log.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.swagger-ui.enabled
properties.description: Swagger UI (springdoc); the URL comes from springdoc.swagger-ui.path: whether to include it in the log.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.open-api-viewer.label
properties.description: Static OpenAPI viewer page (Gradle plugin openApiViewer, Redoc or Scalar): name shown in the log. Defaults to the text for kardx.language.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.open-api-viewer.enabled
properties.description: Static OpenAPI viewer page (Gradle plugin openApiViewer, Redoc or Scalar): whether to include it in the log.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.open-api-viewer.file
properties.description: Static OpenAPI viewer page (Gradle plugin openApiViewer, Redoc or Scalar): file name inside the docs path (docs-path). Matches the plugin's openApiViewer.fileName.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.open-api.label
properties.description: OpenAPI spec file: name shown in the log. Defaults to the text for kardx.language.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.open-api.enabled
properties.description: OpenAPI spec file: whether to include it in the log.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.open-api.file
properties.description: OpenAPI spec file: file name inside the docs path (docs-path).

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.async-api.label
properties.description: WebSocket, STOMP and SSE message docs (AsyncAPI viewer): name shown in the log. Defaults to the text for kardx.language.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.async-api.enabled
properties.description: WebSocket, STOMP and SSE message docs (AsyncAPI viewer): whether to include it in the log.

properties.name: kardx.startup-log.async-api.file
properties.description: WebSocket, STOMP and SSE message docs (AsyncAPI viewer): file name inside the docs path (docs-path).
